rationale: No supported optimization fits this workflow without risking coverage or violating preconditions. The job uses a one-cell matrix (macos-latest / R release) with fail-fast already false, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST would be a no-op and its contraindication (every matrix outcome is required) applies. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is not supported because the only repository dependency file present is Python requirements.txt; there is no R lockfile (e.g., renv.lock) or pinned environment input to key a dependency cache, violating the precondition that cache inputs include lockfile and environment. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT / P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT are not safely supported: CI history is small (5 runs, 2 cancelled, 3 successes around 5-10 minutes) and macOS R CMD check duration can vary with source compilation, so imposing a custom timeout risks failing valid slow runs, which is the pattern's stated contraindication. Keeping the workflow unchanged preserves intended build/test coverage and adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access.
